reviewMeasurementsRevision4.binding: Before and after use the same rebuilt release CLI. The current graph matches the after graph bytes; this annotated plan follows the measured snapshot without further defaults/case changes. No runtime source change.

commands.exitCodes: All eight validations, sixteen inspections and two renders in each before/after run exited 0.

changes: Shared normalized layer shapes A/B generate both C=max(A,B) and D=clamp((A-B+0.1)/0.2,0,1); surface color and grain use D; backing blends in baseColor/roughness use C; height=relief*C and normal derives from that stored height
Default underRatio 0.5 -> 0.25 and relief 0.025 -> 0.0125; ranges unchanged, explicit case overrides preserved
Crown floor 0.4 -> 0.65, crown ceiling 1; original W/F support, widths/counts, fixed crown mortar 0.45/bevel 0.25 and Q bevel 0.25 remain
Removed duplicated two-order color composites and separate coverage union; existing numeric schedule gives 10 textures
Grain remains color/roughness only; relief changes height/normal only. underRatio now changes shared outlines in all nonmetallic channels, including when relief=0

alignment.method: Two ordinary .mix probes through the release Vulkan CLI. Coverage probe: both yarn colors white, backing black, yarn roughness 1/backing 0, expose C as height. Selection probe: warp white/weft black, warpGrain=1/weftGrain=0, roughness ramp 0..1/backing 0; expose scalar-mask-blend(0,D,C) as height. Compare each production baseColor against a separate gradient-map of that same scalar mask, and roughness against scalar height. This handles sRGB vs linear encoding without comparing incompatible byte values.
comparisonArrayMeaning: differing RGB pixels in crop x=64,y=64,width=256,height=256
alignment.limits: Plain 1K neutral probes only. Normal is a derivative of scaled stored C, not an identical mask. No raw-half/full parameter matrix, PBR or cross-runtime qualification.

pinchObservation.method: Render isolated per-thread heights with material-output height rewired; before levels normalizes by 0.025, after A/B already normalized. At each x, y=0..127, count encoded pixels where weft>warp and weft>13/255. This is a bounded RGBA8 dominance observation, not a geometric width gate.

visualObservations: Matched actual baseColor/normal/roughness crops now share the rounded crossing outline; directional grain remains visible

Lower under-thread default and higher crown floor reduce hourglass pinch; lower default relief reduces puffiness. Rounded segment ends remain and final fine-fabric/PBR appearance requires maintainer review

Alternative raised-under-thread, translated-height, narrower-selector and four-sample-selector candidates did not improve the requested appearance enough; multi-sample ramps introduced visible bands and were rejected. No node gap claimed
